name: Edit Image
description: Modify an EXISTING image from the workspace according to a text instruction and save the result as a new file, which is shown to the user automatically. Without a mask the whole picture is redrawn guided by the original (change style, mood, colours, season, add or alter elements); with a mask only the white area of the mask is repainted (inpainting). Write the prompt in English as a description of the WANTED result, not as a command: the image model knows nothing about this conversation and does not understand 'make it darker' — describe the dark version. The original file is never touched.

image.description: Path of the source image in the workspace (e.g. 'bee-on-a-meadow.png', as printed by generate_image or list_dir). PNG, JPEG or WebP.

prompt.description: Description of the final image, in English: subject, setting, style, lighting, colours. Repeat what must stay the same as well as what changes.

mask.description: Optional path of a mask image with the same size as the source: WHITE = area to repaint, BLACK = keep. Without it the whole image is reworked.

strength.description: How far the result may depart from the original, 0.0-1.0. Around 0.3 keeps the composition and only retouches; 0.5-0.7 changes style or mood; above 0.8 keeps little more than the layout. Default 0.6.

negative_prompt.description: What must NOT appear in the result (e.g. 'text, watermark, blurry'). Optional.

steps.description: Denoising steps. Turbo/lightning models want very few (1-8). Leave unset for the configured default.

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed with the same inputs gives the same result. Omit or -1 for a new one.

filename.description: Base name for the saved file, without extension. Optional: derived from the source name.
